title: Evolving Towards Better Codes: LLM-Guided Search for High-Distance Binary Linear Codes
abstract: arXiv:2609.37056v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Evolutionary program search driven by large language models (LLMs) has produced record-breaking constructions for open problems in combinatorics and beyond. We apply this approach to the longstanding problem of improving the best-known bounds for binary linear codes. Building on the EvoTune evolutionary framework and the ShinkaEvolve codebase, we introduce LinCodeEvolve, which evolves code-construction programs against an exact minimum-distance evaluator. A strategy loop combines diversity-driven search and expert supervision: when progress plateaus, new strategies are used to redirect the search. LinCodeEvolve discovers seven record-breaking codes, $[172,21,66]$, $[173,20,68]$, $[176,21,68]$, $[181,21,70]$, $[184,21,72]$, $[189,22,72]$ and $[200,21,77]$, six of which have concise quasi-cyclic descriptions. translated_title: 迈向更优编码的演化：基于大语言模型引导的大距离二元线性码搜索
translated_abstract: 由大语言模型（LLM）驱动的演化程序搜索已在组合数学及其他领域的开放问题上产生了打破纪录的构造。我们将这一方法应用于改进二元线性码已知最优界这一长期存在的问题。基于 EvoTune 演化框架和 ShinkaEvolve 代码库，我们提出了 LinCodeEvolve，它针对精确的最小距离评估器来演化码构造程序。该方法采用一个策略循环，将多样性驱动的搜索与专家监督相结合：当进展陷入停滞时，会启用新的策略来重新引导搜索方向。LinCodeEvolve 发现了七个打破纪录的码：[172,21,66]、[173,20,68]、[176,21,68]、[181,21,70]、[184,21,72]、[189,22,72] 和 [200,21,77]，其中六个具有简洁的准循环描述。借助标准的码修改技术，这些码改进了码表中的 22 个条目。每个码都通过穷举枚举进行了验证。
tldr: 提出 LinCodeEvolve 框架，利用大语言模型引导的演化程序搜索，发现了七个打破纪录的大距离二元线性码，并通过标准码修改技术改进了码表中的 22 个条目。
en_tdlr: LinCodeEvolve, an LLM-guided evolutionary program search framework, discovers seven record-breaking high-distance binary linear codes and improves 22 entries of the code tables via standard code modification techniques.
